Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments. We are looking for a Consulting Analyst whose primary strength is in AI agentic systems—someone with genuine, hands-on experience building, testing, and deploying agentic workflows—and who is eager to apply that expertise within the payments and financial services industry. This is not a pure AI engineering role, nor is it a traditional consulting analyst position. It is a hybrid, execution-focused role where AI capability complemented by an interest in and aptitude for financial services are the leading qualifications. The ideal candidate is technically capable and intellectually curious: someone who can design a prompt architecture for an agent that automates a bank’s operational workflow, run structured evaluations to measure quality and reliability, and present findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. You bring strong AI foundations and are excited about developing domain expertise in payments and financial services—one of the most complex, regulated, and high-impact sectors for agentic AI deployment. Design and execute structured evaluation cycles: create test cases, analyze agent outputs for factuality, format compliance, and task completion, and document failure modes with actionable improvement recommendations. Maintain and evolve prompt libraries, evaluation datasets, and experimentation logs—contributing to the team’s systematic approach to prompt versioning, A/B testing, and performance tracking. Monitor the agentic AI landscape—tracking new models, frameworks, protocols (Visa TAP, OpenAI/Stripe ACP, Google AP2), and techniques—and synthesize findings into internal briefings and knowledge-sharing materials. Prototype and demonstrate new agent capabilities, translating emerging AI techniques into practical solutions that address real client challenges. Support the execution of AI agentic workflow engagements for Visa’s financial institution and merchant clients across Southern Europe, contributing to workstreams from discovery and process mapping through agent development, testing, and deployment. Conduct research and analysis to identify client processes suited for agentization—mapping document flows, system integration points, decision trees, and existing automation gaps across payments, banking operations, and financial services workflows. Assist in the design of hybrid AI-human operating models, documenting task routing logic, escalation paths, and human oversight requirements for regulatory-sensitive processes. Help translate financial services domain requirements—such as compliance rules, authorization flows, customer onboarding processes, and settlement logic—into agent specifications, evaluation criteria, and structured system prompts. Prepare client-facing deliverables including process assessments, technical documentation, and progress reports, ensuring quality and consistency with VCA standards. Contribute to go-to-market activities for the AI Agentic Workflows and Agentic Commerce service lines, including research for client workshops, preparation of capability demonstrations, and drafting of sales materials. Support the development of client proposals by conducting market research, competitive analysis, and benchmarking exercises that feed into ROI projections and implementation plans. Help build the service line’s intellectual capital: contribute to frameworks, playbooks, reusable prompt templates, evaluation benchmarks, and case study documentation. Participate in client meetings and workshops alongside senior team members, taking ownership of specific technical analysis workstreams or agent demonstration components. Apply your AI expertise to one of the most complex and high-impact sectors for agentic deployment—developing rare, differentiated skills at the intersection of AI and financial services. Work alongside senior leaders and directly with C-level executives at Europe’s leading financial institutions on real, transformative engagements. Access Visa’s unmatched payments data, global subject matter experts, and proprietary technology platforms—resources unavailable anywhere else. Accelerate your domain expertise through hands-on project work, structured mentoring from payments and AI specialists, and continuous learning opportunities. Contribute to defining the playbook for an entirely new consulting discipline, with direct visibility to Visa’s senior leadership. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a structured approach to ambiguous problems. Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Spanish; additional European languages are a plus. Clear and professional presentation skills—comfortable preparing and contributing to deliverables for senior client audiences. Awareness of the emerging agentic commerce protocol landscape: Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay, OpenAI/Stripe ACP, Google AP2, and related standards. Contributions to the AI community—through personal projects, open-source contributions, hackathons, published articles, or relevant certifications—that demonstrate initiative and depth beyond formal job requirements. AI interfaces: familiarity with how end users interact with AI applications (chatbots, copilots, browser extensions, agent-based tools) and the design considerations involved. Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

TEAM

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry.

Within the Data team, you’ll join the BI/Prediction Team which is an autonomous squad of around 10 people. The team is composed of top-tier product managers, software & data engineers, data scientists and data analysts.

ROLE

The objective of this team is to accelerate the growth of the company by serving as the on-demand prediction provider for all Voodoo BUs. This involves addressing critical needs such as predicting campaign LTV for User Acquisition optimization, determining optimal monetization offers for millions of players or constructing confidence intervals for time series data prediction.

We want to onboard a passionate senior data scientist with significant experience in a similar environment to allow us to go one step further. This is an opportunity to have a strategic and critical impact on Voodoo’s success.

This position is hybrid and requires 3 days per week in the office based in Paris.

- Take ownership of our products modeling pipelines

- Contribute to high modeling performance through insightful ideas and initiatives.

- Build and deploy quickly scalable ML systems.

- Engage with colleagues across the company to leverage new ideas and perspectives and demonstrate excellent communication to efficiently cooperate with product managers, teammates and stakeholders.

- Deep dive into data to discover relevant insights.

- Build a rich understanding of the mobile gaming industry, the company strategy, our products and their fit within the company’s daily operations.

- Mentor and guide a team of data scientists, fostering technical excellence and autonomy.

- Establish and enforce best practices in ML engineering, experimentation, and reproducibility across projects.

- Champion a culture of impact-driven research, ensuring models not only perform well technically but also create tangible business value.

- Proactively identify risks in modeling approaches, data quality, scalability, business alignment and design mitigation strategies.

PROFILE

- Extensive experience building machine learning systems

- Extensive experience with Python, SQL and MLOps best practices

- Cloud experience needed (ideally AWS but could be another cloud provider)

- Airflow and DBT experience is a nice to have

- Excellent Communication in English and French mandatory

- You enjoy working in a team, learning new things, sharing knowledge

- Experience in a tech startup/scaleup is a plus

- Strong achievements on Kaggle will be valued

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary

- Comprehensive relocation package (including visa support)

- Premium healthcare (SideCare) for you and your family 100% borne by Voodoo

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

- Unlimited vacation policy

- Remote days

SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a highly skilled Electrical Commissioning Technician to support the buildout and energization of SpaceXAI's high-performance data centers. In this critical hands-on role, you will perform commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of electrical systems that power our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with construction, engineering, and operations teams to ensure safe, reliable, and high-quality electrical systems from initial installation through full system turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXAI data center sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Execute electrical commissioning activities for medium and low voltage power distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, PDUs, and associated controls in data center environments.
• Perform point-to-point wiring checks, functional testing, calibration, and system integration verification.
• Troubleshoot and resolve electrical issues during pre-commissioning, commissioning, and startup phases.
• Develop and execute detailed commissioning test procedures, scripts, and documentation in accordance with project specifications and industry standards.
• Collaborate with EPC contractors, OEM vendors, and SpaceXAI engineers to coordinate energization sequences and integrated system testing.
• Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, LOTO procedures, and quality standards during all commissioning activities.
• Maintain accurate as-built documentation, test records, and commissioning reports.
• Support training of operations and maintenance teams on commissioned electrical systems.
• Participate in constructability reviews and provide field feedback to improve design and installation quality.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3+ years of hands-on electrical commissioning or field technician experience in data centers, power plants, or large industrial facilities.
• Strong working knowledge of electrical systems up to 480V (medium voltage experience preferred), including switchgear, motor control centers, variable frequency drives, and protective relaying.
• Experience with commissioning test equipment (meggers, multimeters, relay test sets, power quality analyzers, etc.).
• Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, NETA).
• Demonstrated ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, schematics, and one-line diagrams.
• Strong safety mindset with current OSHA 10/30 or equivalent training.
• Willingness to work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical commissioning windows.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Prior commissioning experience on hyperscale data center projects or mission-critical facilities.
• NETA certification (Level II or higher) or equivalent (e.g., NICET, Journeyman Electrician license).
• Experience with data center power infrastructure including redundant UPS, generators, and busway systems.
• Knowledge of PLC/controls troubleshooting and SCADA systems.
• Proficiency with commissioning management software (e.g., CxPro, Procore, or similar).
• Technical degree or trade school certification in Electrical Engineering Technology or related field.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to travel extensively to SpaceXAI construction sites and remain onsite during peak commissioning phases.
• Capability to work in industrial environments, climb ladders, lift moderate loads, and wear PPE for extended periods.

Support technology maturation, risk reduction, and transition of validated solutions into production programs. 我們正在尋找一位反應敏銳、能獨立作業的選品專案組長，負責推動專案目標並管理一個 5 至 10 人的小團隊。這份工作不僅僅是執行檢查清單，我們更需要一位能全權負責工作流程、洞察細節，並確保團隊維持高生產力與準確性的關鍵人才。

核心重點
• 營運所有權：管理每日人力配置，確保團隊達成目標。

主要職責
• 團隊領導與自主管理：以高度責任感帶領 5 至 10 人的團隊；獨立管理專案人力分配與日常營運，確保專案成功。
• 績效與考勤管理：監控團隊出勤狀況並進行績效考核，確保所有成員持續達到或超越團隊標準。

• 主管支援：在極少監督的情況下，高效完成主管交辦任務，支援部門整體目標。

• 邏輯思考與適應力：具備嚴謹的邏輯推理能力，能處理複雜數據；作為自驅型人才，需能適應變化，並在動態環境中帶領團隊達成目標。

• 電商熱忱：對電子商務營運與市場趨勢有濃厚興趣，並致力於自我持續成長。
加分條件
• 數據處理能力：精通 Excel 進階函數進行數據分析（如：XLOOKUP, COUNTIFS）。

• 培訓與指導經驗：曾有領導、教練或培訓團隊成員以提升整體績效的實績。

• 如果發現候選人在申請過程中提交了虛假信息，Coupang 有權撤銷聘用邀請。

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

We are seeking a Sr. Category Manager to strategically source products and services within our Global Procurement Organization, Equipment Category with a focus on MHE (Material Handling Equipment). The person in this role will coordinate with several teams across Amazon and will interact with our most important suppliers to satisfy organizational requirements. The position will work and partner with multiple teams to develop and execute category sourcing strategies, deliver savings and improve productivity across the category. The ideal candidate is a self-starter, and a creative, critical thinker with motivation to learn. You must be an effective communicator and be able to work independently and as a leader of peers to generate high-quality work product in a collaborative, creative, ever-changing, and sometimes ambiguous environment. You must have a professional demeanor and be able to partner with people at every level.

Key job responsibilities
- Establish category sourcing strategies, lead cross-functional strategic sourcing teams, negotiate with suppliers and execute contracts to optimize Amazon’s competitive position
- Drive appropriate relationships with category suppliers, with a principal objective of achieving the optimal solution and cost of ownership that meets the business’ goals supported by a culture of continuous improvement with performance benchmarks in use
- Manage category suppliers to proactively identify, monitor and optimize opportunities
- Act as a market intelligence provider regarding categories; anticipate strategic opportunities and keep key stakeholders informed
- Drive category suppliers in Supplier Relationship Management activities to mitigate risk, improve performance and add value to Amazon
- Identify, achieve and report on savings and value targets for category sourcing activities
- Align with internal customers and understand the business application of the category
Key Performance Indicators:
- Earn the trust of key stakeholders to drive alignment with the business
- Create a category strategy in conjunction with internal customers to ensure there is a comprehensive, unified approach for the category.
- Achieve yearly cost saving or value targets appropriate to the category aligned with annual budget processes.
- Define and report on key metrics that measure effectiveness of supply and cost savings
- Champion standards and process improvements

jobs.description: Amazon Australia's Retail team is looking for a Senior Category Manager to join us as we continue growing and setting new standards in e-commerce for Australian customers. If you're passionate about delivering results, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to make a real impact on how Australians shop, this role could be perfect for you. This is a strategic, hands-on role requiring deep commercial acumen, full P&L ownership, and the ability to drive analysis that directly impacts business performance. A critical aspect is leading complex commercial negotiations with key vendors and strategic partners - structuring deals that drive mutual growth while balancing short-term targets with long-term partnership value. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, finance, supply chain teams, and brand partners to drive category growth. As an individual contributor, you'll deliver results through influence, mentor team members, and act as a Subject Matter Expert across the organisation. A successful Senior Category Manager will: - Own category outcomes end-to-end: taking full ownership of your category's P&L, setting strategic direction, driving ranging and investment decisions, and identifying operational efficiencies - Lead complex negotiations: confidently navigating senior stakeholder relationships and structuring commercial deals that optimise terms, pricing, and promotional investment while building long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships - Bring analytical depth and commercial rigour: diving deep in the data to uncover insights, build compelling business cases, and translate complex analysis into actionable category strategies - Know your market: developing deep expertise in your category's competitive landscape, seasonality, and customer trends and using the knowledge to inform strategic decisions - Be solutions-oriented at scale: proactively identifying challenges and opportunities across your portfolio, and always working backwards from the customer - Technology & AI Adoption: Embrace AI and new technologies, diving into Amazon's tools and systems quickly and confidently Amazon values diverse experiences and candidates with transferable skills are encouraged to apply. We are hiring across multiple business units and will match your profile to a category through the hiring process: - Consumables (Grocery, Beauty, Household, Pet, Personal Care or Baby) - Fashion (Luggage, Shoes, Watches or Clothing) - Electronics (Audio, Consumer Electronics, TV or Camera) - Home & Living (Toys, Kitchen, Sports, Lawn and Garden or Office) - Entertainment (Physical Books, Video Games, Music, or Digital Products) Why Amazon? Beyond joining one of the world's most customer-centric companies, you'll enjoy a range of benefits that make Amazon a great place to work: - Dogs at Work: our popular program proven to lower stress and boost morale, running successfully across our Australian corporate offices - Commuter benefits, helping you save on the cost of your daily commute - Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, on top of salary continuance (income protection) and life insurance - Inclusive culture: Amazon celebrates diversity of background, experience, and thought as a key driver of innovation and our mission to be the most customer-centric company in the world This position requires full-time in-office presence 5 days per week at our CBD location. Key job responsibilities - Own Category Strategy & P&L: Develop data-driven, customer-centric strategies leveraging market trends, competitive analysis, and customer insights. Take full financial ownership to meet and exceed revenue and profitability targets. - Curate Selection & Drive Ranging: Lead assortment planning, line reviews, and item forecasting across direct and indirect supply, prioritising key brands and terms. - Lead Supplier Negotiations: Build strong partnerships with leading brands, negotiating deals that optimise terms, pricing, promotional investment, and exclusive access to new products. - Drive Pricing, Promotions & Demand Planning: Shape pricing strategies balancing profitability with customer value. Coordinate promotional execution with vendors and internal teams. Create demand forecasts and monitor inventory to minimise stock-out and overstock risk. - Bring Analytical Depth: Dive deep into data to uncover insights, build business cases, and translate analysis into actionable strategies. Monitor performance and lead testing initiatives. - Manage Day-to-Day Operations: Oversee customer feedback, price monitoring, item-level data accuracy, regulatory compliance, and technical supplier integration. - Collaborate, Influence & Mentor: Partner with Merchandising, Operations, Procurement, Finance, and Marketing. Act as a brand ambassador externally and mentor team members internally. - Embrace Technology & AI: Adopt new technologies and Amazon's tools quickly and confidently." A day in the life Your day will be dynamic and collaborative, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll lead commercial negotiations with key partners, dive deep into category performance data, and develop strategies that drive results. Expect to move between complex analytical work, cross-functional alignment, and senior stakeholder engagement. Our team thrives on diverse perspectives, collaborative problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous learning. We believe in empowering individuals to make meaningful impacts that transform how Australians shop online.
